snippet.title: Scrappy Craft - Find Junk & Craft Weapons for Customers - Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
A shop keeper game where you run a small forge. Scavenge trash and combine it to craft over 10,000 absurd weapons like banana swords or frisbee shields, buy upgrades, unlock new recipes, and sell your bizarre creations to quirky customers like tie-wearing otters or spaghetti monsters.

Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4359360/Scrappy_Craft/
